LanguageData.LP_TitanStature.label: titanborn body
LanguageData.LP_TitanStature.description: A titanborn body two and a half times human height: actual body size ×250%, drawn ×160%, hauling another ×120%; eats 1.5× as much as normal, stomach ×250%, long strides but not fast (move speed ×90%). Giant-body rules give the titanborn health ×175% and melee ×145%.
LanguageData.LP_TitanDivinity.label: divine might
LanguageData.LP_TitanDivinity.description: A titanborn's divinity, shown as the "divine might" resource bar (0-100): recovers 10 per day naturally, another 10 per day while mood ≥80%, and +5 per enemy killed. Divine might is used for "divine punishment" (30) and "titanborn's breath" (40). A faint golden halo hangs over the head.
LanguageData.LP_TitanDivinity.resourceDescription: A titanborn's divine might. Recovers daily and also increases with kills; spent by divine punishment and titanborn's breath.
LanguageData.LP_TitanWeather.label: weather of the heart
LanguageData.LP_TitanWeather.description: A titanborn's moods are written in the sky: while the titanborn is on the map, its mood is checked at dawn each day: mood ≥80% turns the weather clear, mood ≤30% turns it to thunderstorm, otherwise no interference. Only affects the map the titanborn is on. Can be turned off in mod settings.
LanguageData.LP_TitanUnshakable.label: unshakable
LanguageData.LP_TitanUnshakable.description: Titanborn can't be stunned (including by EMP), mind resistance +50%.
LanguageData.LP_SkinTitan.label: golden-bronze skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinTitan.description: The golden-bronze skin of a titanborn, faintly gleaming in the sunlight.
